title: Man arrested in connection with assault in which two Brentford players intervened
content:
A man has been arrested in connection with an investigation into an alleged assault in which two Brentford players attempted to intervene.

The Metropolitan Police confirmed to The Athletic that a 63-year-old man was arrested on Tuesday, March 24 on suspicion of common assault, attempted criminal damage, and a racially aggravated public order offence.

Police said they were called in the early hours of the morning of Sunday, March 22, several hours after Brentford’s goalless draw with Leeds United at Elland Road on Saturday, following a report of assault in Richmond, west London. The Met confirmed that the victim of the alleged assault was not injured and that they had identified a second victim who had been subjected to racially aggravated verbal abuse after more enquiries.

The Brentford players had attempted to intervene in the incident.

The Premier League side declined to comment when approached by The Athletic.

Brentford are seventh in the Premier League and are next in action against Everton at the Gtech Community Stadium on April 11.
